proves.claim: The notBuilder precondition lets the builder reserve and accept its own submitted item when soloLowStakes is true, every row is low-stakes and person-approved and every check is machine-run red before and green after.

moves.lifecycle-rules.builder-self-accep.why: Self-accept on low-stakes machine-checked rows is the allowed exception to independent verification (#966).

proves.claim: SELF_VERIFY still refuses the builder unless every low-stakes, person-approved and machine-run red then green condition holds, and always for reject and review-landed.

moves.lifecycle-rules.self-verify-still-.why: A builder must never verify its own work outside the one declared exception (#966).
